info.title: 25-Year-Old High School Girl
info.synopsis: La storia racconta le vicende di Hana Natori, una donna di 25 anni di indole gentile con una cugina che non vuole andare alle superiori. Hana prende il suo posto a scuola, ma viene riconosciuta da Okito Kanie, professore di storia mondiale e suo ex-compagno di classe.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: This 25 year old will go to school pretending to be her truant younger cousin! While she can handle going to class, she has trouble following all the showy pretenses of high school life and ends up in a tough spot, forcing her to take refuge in the nurse’s office when all of a sudden Kanie, a teacher, greets her by saying, “Aren’t you Hana Natori?”, which totally blows her cover. In a surprising turn of events, it turns out that Kanie was a former classmate of hers back in high school! Moreover, without any warning he asks her, “do you know what to do to keep a man quiet?” and starts kissing her deeply, pushing her down in the process! With secrets piling up on one another, there’s no running away!

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Season overview: The romance story centers around Hana Natori, an earnest, good-natured 25-year-old woman whose cousin refuses to go to high school. Hana takes her cousin's place and attends the high school. On her first day, though, Hana's ruse is discovered by her former high school classmate Okito Kanie—who happens to be the high school's world history teacher.
